The Platform shall allow a user to create a Buyer account using a unique identifier (mobile number and/or email address).

rationale: Enables inclusive access and repeat usage through account-based services.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can submit registration data and receive account creation confirmation.
2. Platform prevents creation of duplicate accounts with the same unique identifier.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Administrator can configure allowed authentication factors.
2. User can authenticate successfully using an allowed factor and is denied for a disallowed factor.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can initiate recovery and complete recovery using a verified contact method.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can view and update profile fields.

text: The Platform shall support Seller identity linkage to mobile-money verified identities where feasible (KYC leveraging national IDs linked to mobile accounts).
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration)
shall: The Platform shall support Seller identity linkage to mobile-money verified identities where feasible (KYC leveraging national IDs linked to mobile accounts).
rationale: Derisks onboarding and supports compliance as per feasibility analysis.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can provide mobile number used for mobile-money KYC linkage.
2. System stores verification outcome from payment provider or KYC service if integrated.

text: The Platform shall provide reporting on Seller onboarding funnel (registered, submitted, approved, rejected) and cycle time.
shall: The Platform shall provide reporting on Seller onboarding funnel (registered, submitted, approved, rejected) and cycle time.
rationale: Enables governance and capacity planning.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Report shows counts by status and average time to approve.
2. Report can be exported to CSV/PDF.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to temporarily pause sales/listings (vacation mode) with customer-facing messaging.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to temporarily pause sales/listings (vacation mode) with customer-facing messaging.
rationale: Supports operational realities and reduces cancellations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can enable/disable pause status.
2. When paused, checkout is blocked for Seller listings and messaging is displayed.

text: The Platform shall allow Buyers to rate Sellers and provide feedback after order completion, with moderation controls for abuse.
shall: The Platform shall allow Buyers to rate Sellers and provide feedback after order completion, with moderation controls for abuse.
rationale: Builds trust and helps highlight reliable sellers, addressing adoption barriers related to fraud concerns.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can submit rating/feedback only for completed orders.
2. Admin can moderate/remove feedback with reason code and audit trail.

text: The Platform shall allow an approved Seller to create and manage product listings with mandatory fields (title, description, price, stock, images).
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: category carried by the mapped features
shall: The Platform shall allow an approved Seller to create and manage product listings with mandatory fields (title, description, price, stock, images).
rationale: Enables digital marketplace listings with minimum quality standard.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can create a listing and save as draft.
2. System validates mandatory fields before publication.

text: The Platform shall support product categorization using an Admin-managed category taxonomy.
shall: The Platform shall support product categorization using an Admin-managed category taxonomy.
rationale: Improves search/discovery and reporting.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can create/edit categories.
2. Seller must select category when creating a product.

text: The Platform shall support product variants (e.g., size, color) with separate SKU, price, and stock per variant.
shall: The Platform shall support product variants (e.g., size, color) with separate SKU, price, and stock per variant.
rationale: Supports common retail requirements and reduces listing duplication.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can define variants and assign SKU/price/stock.
2. Buyer can select variants during purchase and stock is deducted correctly.

text: The Platform shall support bulk product upload and update using a standard template (CSV/Excel) with validation feedback.
shall: The Platform shall support bulk product upload and update using a standard template (CSV/Excel) with validation feedback.
rationale: Reduces onboarding friction for SMEs with many products.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can download template and upload file.
2. System provides error report for invalid rows and imports valid rows.

text: The Platform shall support product inventory management including stock quantities and low-stock alerts configurable by Seller.
shall: The Platform shall support product inventory management including stock quantities and low-stock alerts configurable by Seller.
rationale: Reduces out-of-stock cancellations and improves customer experience.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can update stock quantity.
2. Low-stock alert triggers when threshold is reached and is visible in Seller dashboard.

text: The Platform shall support scheduling of product availability (start/end dates) and pre-order listings where applicable.
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native available start/end dates and pre-order fields
shall: The Platform shall support scheduling of product availability (start/end dates) and pre-order listings where applicable.
rationale: Supports planned campaigns and demand generation.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can set availability dates.
2. Product is not purchasable outside availability dates.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to define product fulfilment attributes required for logistics (weight, dimensions, fragility, handling notes).
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to define product fulfilment attributes required for logistics (weight, dimensions, fragility, handling notes).
rationale: Enables accurate shipping pricing and operations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can enter required fulfilment attributes.
2. Order shipping label includes relevant handling notes.

text: The Platform shall support an Admin moderation workflow for product listings (approve, reject, request changes) with reasons.
shall: The Platform shall support an Admin moderation workflow for product listings (approve, reject, request changes) with reasons.
rationale: Reduces prohibited items and improves listing quality.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can approve/reject listing with reason.
2. Seller receives notification and can resubmit.

text: The Platform shall allow Admin to define prohibited product categories/items and enforce automated checks where feasible.
shall: The Platform shall allow Admin to define prohibited product categories/items and enforce automated checks where feasible.
rationale: Supports marketplace rules and consumer protection.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure prohibited rules.
2. System blocks publication of prohibited listings and logs the event.

text: The Platform shall support image and document uploads for product listings with server-side validation (file type, size limits) configurable by Admin.
shall: The Platform shall support image and document uploads for product listings with server-side validation (file type, size limits) configurable by Admin.
rationale: Supports consistent quality and system performance.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System accepts allowed file types and rejects disallowed types.
2. Admin can configure size limits.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to manage pricing including base price, discounts, and promotional pricing with effective dates.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to manage pricing including base price, discounts, and promotional pricing with effective dates.
rationale: Enables competitive pricing and campaigns to drive adoption.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can set discount price and dates.
2. Buyer sees correct price during effective period.

text: The Platform shall support platform-level promotions (sitewide campaigns, category campaigns) managed by Admin.
shall: The Platform shall support platform-level promotions (sitewide campaigns, category campaigns) managed by Admin.
rationale: Supports trust & demand generation initiatives.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can create campaigns and define eligibility rules.
2. Eligible products show campaign pricing/badges.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to configure tax/duty-related fields required for cross-border shipments where applicable.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to configure tax/duty-related fields required for cross-border shipments where applicable.
rationale: Supports cross-border readiness for phased regional services.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can enter HS code / country of origin fields where required.
2. Export for customs includes the captured fields for eligible orders.

text: The Platform shall generate unique product identifiers (SKU) and maintain product version history for audit.
shall: The Platform shall generate unique product identifiers (SKU) and maintain product version history for audit.
rationale: Supports traceability and dispute resolution.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Each product has unique SKU.
2. System records version history when key fields are changed.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to create product bundles/kits and define bundle pricing.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to create product bundles/kits and define bundle pricing.
rationale: Supports value-added sales and logistics efficiency.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can create a bundle from component products.
2. Stock deductions occur for components upon sale.

text: The Platform shall provide catalog analytics for Admin (active listings, categories, out-of-stock rate, listing rejection reasons).
shall: The Platform shall provide catalog analytics for Admin (active listings, categories, out-of-stock rate, listing rejection reasons).
rationale: Supports platform governance and continuous improvement.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can view analytics dashboards.
2. Dashboard data is filterable by date range and category.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to manage returnability settings per product consistent with platform returns policy.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to manage returnability settings per product consistent with platform returns policy.
rationale: Supports hybrid returns handling and clear buyer expectations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can select allowed return window and conditions within policy constraints.
2. Buyer sees return policy on product page.

text: The Platform shall display product details including price, seller, delivery options, estimated delivery timelines, and returns policy summary.
shall: The Platform shall display product details including price, seller, delivery options, estimated delivery timelines, and returns policy summary.
rationale: Builds trust and supports informed purchase decisions.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Product page displays required information for published products.
2. Delivery options/timelines update based on buyer location or selected pickup.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to set geographic delivery coverage constraints where applicable (e.g., deliverable districts) and enforce them at checkout.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to set geographic delivery coverage constraints where applicable (e.g., deliverable districts) and enforce them at checkout.
rationale: Prevents orders that cannot be delivered reliably.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can define coverage constraints.
2. Checkout blocks orders outside coverage and provides message.

text: The Platform shall support a featured listing/advertising mechanism with configurable placement rules and fees.
shall: The Platform shall support a featured listing/advertising mechanism with configurable placement rules and fees.
rationale: Supports diversified revenue mix through advertising/listing fees.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can designate featured listings and set duration/fee.
2. Featured listings display in defined placements and expire automatically.

text: The Platform shall provide seller-side catalog quality checks (missing fields, image quality prompts) before submission for approval.
shall: The Platform shall provide seller-side catalog quality checks (missing fields, image quality prompts) before submission for approval.
rationale: Improves catalog quality and reduces moderation workload.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System flags missing/low-quality data prior to submission.
2. Seller can correct flagged issues before submitting.

text: The Platform shall provide an API endpoint (via the Integration Layer) to expose product catalog data to authorized internal services (e.g., CRM, analytics) and external partners as permitted.
shall: The Platform shall provide an API endpoint (via the Integration Layer) to expose product catalog data to authorized internal services (e.g., CRM, analytics) and external partners as permitted.
rationale: Supports modular architecture and data reuse.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. API endpoints are documented and secured.
2. Only authorized clients can access catalog APIs.

text: The Platform shall support product takedown requests and evidence capture for regulatory or policy compliance.
shall: The Platform shall support product takedown requests and evidence capture for regulatory or policy compliance.
rationale: Enables compliance management and audit readiness.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can disable a product and record reason/evidence attachments.
2. Takedown action is reflected on site immediately and logged.

text: The Platform shall allow Sellers to manage service listings (non-physical services) where enabled, with delivery method and fulfillment confirmation.
shall: The Platform shall allow Sellers to manage service listings (non-physical services) where enabled, with delivery method and fulfillment confirmation.
rationale: Supports priority private-sector service use cases and diversified revenue.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can create service listing with delivery method (digital/in-person).
2. Order completion requires seller confirmation of service delivery.

text: The Platform shall allow Buyers to submit product ratings and reviews after purchase, with moderation and fraud controls.
shall: The Platform shall allow Buyers to submit product ratings and reviews after purchase, with moderation and fraud controls.
rationale: Builds trust and improves discovery through social proof.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can review only products purchased and delivered/collected.
2. Admin can moderate reviews and the moderation actions are logged.

text: The Platform shall provide keyword search over product and service listings.
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native keyword search; natural-language search not required
shall: The Platform shall provide keyword search over product and service listings.
rationale: Enables discovery of marketplace items.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Search returns results relevant to keywords in title/description/category.
2. Search returns a consistent result count and supports pagination.

text: The Platform shall provide faceted filtering of search results by category, price range, seller, location, and delivery option.
shall: The Platform shall provide faceted filtering of search results by category, price range, seller, location, and delivery option.
rationale: Improves findability and conversion.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can apply multiple filters and results update accordingly.
2. Applied filters are visible and removable.

text: The Platform shall provide sorting options for search and category listings (e.g., relevance, price, popularity, newest, place of origin).
shall: The Platform shall provide sorting options for search and category listings (e.g., relevance, price, popularity, newest, place of origin).
rationale: Supports buyer decision-making and user experience.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can change sort order and results update accordingly.
2. Selected sort order persists during the session.

text: The Platform shall provide auto-suggest and search-as-you-type suggestions.
shall: The Platform shall provide auto-suggest and search-as-you-type suggestions.
rationale: Reduces friction for mobile-first users.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. As user types, suggestions appear within 1 second in a demo environment.
2. Suggestions include product names and categories.

text: The Platform shall provide category browsing pages with curated subcategories and featured items.
shall: The Platform shall provide category browsing pages with curated subcategories and featured items.
rationale: Supports non-search browsing and marketing campaigns.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Category pages display subcategories and selected featured items.
2. Admin can configure featured items for category pages.

text: The Platform shall provide personalized recommendations based on browsing and purchase history where consented.
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration)
shall: The Platform shall provide personalized recommendations based on browsing and purchase history where consented.
rationale: Improves conversion and user engagement.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. With consent enabled, user sees recommendations derived from history.
2. User can opt out of personalization and recommendations revert to non-personalized.

text: The Platform shall allow Admin to configure featured placements (homepage banners, featured sellers, featured categories) with start/end dates.
notes: Code-level modification | mapping added; roll-up = minimal sufficient set: category carried by the mapped features
shall: The Platform shall allow Admin to configure featured placements (homepage banners, featured sellers, featured categories) with start/end dates.
rationale: Supports trust & demand generation and advertising revenue.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can publish a banner/featured placement with schedule.
2. Featured placement expires automatically at end date.

text: The Platform shall display Seller badges (e.g., verified seller, top-rated) as configured by Admin.
shall: The Platform shall display Seller badges (e.g., verified seller, top-rated) as configured by Admin.
rationale: Builds trust and guides buyers to reliable sellers.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Verified badge displays for sellers with Verified status.
2. Badge rules are consistent across listing and product pages.

text: The Platform shall support a 'nearby pickup' discovery mode based on selected pickup outlet or district.
shall: The Platform shall support a 'nearby pickup' discovery mode based on selected pickup outlet or district.
rationale: Leverages MPC physical network for click-and-collect.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can select a pickup outlet/district and view eligible items/services.
2. Eligibility rules are applied consistently at checkout.

text: The Platform shall provide product comparison functionality for selected attributes within a category.
notes: Reusable — configuration | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): comparison covered (SRC-013); restriction "within a category" is not in the 5.00 fit and not specified
shall: The Platform shall provide product comparison functionality for selected attributes within a category.
rationale: Supports informed purchasing and trust.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can select at least two products and view a comparison table.
2. Comparison includes price, key attributes, seller rating, delivery options.

text: The Platform shall provide a Wishlist/favorites feature for buyers.
shall: The Platform shall provide a wishlist/favorites feature for buyers.
rationale: Supports repeat engagement and conversion.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can add/remove items from wishlist.
2. Wishlist persists across sessions for logged-in users.

text: The Platform shall provide a 'recently viewed' list for buyers.
shall: The Platform shall provide a 'recently viewed' list for buyers.
rationale: Improves user experience for mobile-first browsing.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Recently viewed list shows last N viewed items (N configurable).
2. List updates in real time as user views items.

text: The Platform shall display clear delivery promise indicators (estimated delivery window, pickup availability) on listing cards and product pages.
shall: The Platform shall display clear delivery promise indicators (estimated delivery window, pickup availability) on listing cards and product pages.
rationale: Addresses logistics trust barriers and improves conversion.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Delivery indicators display for items with configured logistics rules.
2. If delivery promise cannot be computed, system displays a standard 'Specified location is not available, please select your nearest post office location' message and logs exception.

text: The Platform shall support search for e-government services and display a structured service catalogue (fees, required documents, delivery options).
notes: Reusable — configuration | Table 13 pending; e-Gov scope FG-06/O-2 open
shall: The Platform shall support search for e-government services and display a structured service catalogue (fees, required documents, delivery options).
rationale: Supports integration of priority e-government services in a single portal.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can search and browse e-government service catalogue entries.
2. Service entry includes fee, description, required inputs, and fulfilment method.

text: The Platform shall provide configurable search relevance tuning (boosting by category, featured status, location) with audit of changes.
notes: Code-level modification | closed by SRC-014 amended; Admin boosting rules (category, featured, location) and audit of changes not in PRD-SRC-014 description
shall: The Platform shall provide configurable search relevance tuning (boosting by category, featured status, location) with audit of changes.
rationale: Supports marketplace governance and anti-abuse controls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can change boosting rules and changes are logged.
2. Search results reflect updated boosting rules.

text: The Platform shall provide category and search result analytics (click-through rates, conversion) to Admin reporting.
notes: Code-level modification | mapping added; roll-up = minimal sufficient set: category carried by the mapped features
shall: The Platform shall provide category and search result analytics (click-through rates, conversion) to Admin reporting.
rationale: Supports KPI-driven monitoring of adoption.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can view CTR and conversion by category/search term.
2. Reports can be exported.

text: The Platform shall provide accessibility-friendly search and navigation (keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels) as applicable to web channels.
shall: The Platform shall provide accessibility-friendly search and navigation (keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels) as applicable to web channels.
rationale: Supports inclusive access as Platform scales.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Key pages pass an accessibility checklist during inspection.
2. No critical accessibility issues remain open at go-live.

text: The Platform shall provide a mechanism for users to report suspicious listings or fraud concerns from product/search pages.
shall: The Platform shall provide a mechanism for users to report suspicious listings or fraud concerns from product/search pages.
rationale: Supports trust-building and fraud controls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Report button is available on listings.
2. Reports are captured with item ID and user details and routed to Admin queue.

text: The Platform shall support dynamic category landing pages for campaigns with configurable layout components.
notes: Reusable — configuration (licensed plugin) | subject to V-01 (5.00 availability of the licensed plugin; not verifiable from source)
shall: The Platform shall support dynamic category landing pages for campaigns with configurable layout components.
rationale: Supports marketing and trust/demand generation.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can create a landing page with components (banner, categories, product blocks).
2. Landing page can be published/unpublished without code change.

text: The Platform shall support multilingual search matching where multiple language packs are configured.
shall: The Platform shall support multilingual search matching where multiple language packs are configured.
rationale: Improves discovery where local language terms differ.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. When language packs are enabled, search returns relevant items in both languages.
2. Language packs can be enabled/disabled by Admin.

text: The Platform shall provide offline-friendly error handling and retry prompts for search under intermittent connectivity.
shall: The Platform shall provide offline-friendly error handling and retry prompts for search under intermittent connectivity.
rationale: Addresses unreliable internet connectivity at outlets and rural areas.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. When connection drops, user receives a clear message and option to retry.
2. No data corruption occurs; user can return to last known state.

text: The Platform shall provide an API for search queries and results to support integration with other channels (e.g., USSD/SMS inquiry or kiosk) where implemented.
shall: The Platform shall provide an API for search queries and results to support integration with other channels (e.g., USSD/SMS inquiry or kiosk) where implemented.
rationale: Enables multi-channel expansion using MPC footprint.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. API endpoints are documented and secured.
2. Demonstration of an external client retrieving results via API.

text: The Platform shall ensure that search results exclude unpublished, suspended, or out-of-stock items according to configurable rules.
shall: The Platform shall ensure that search results exclude unpublished, suspended, or out-of-stock items according to configurable rules.
rationale: Reduces buyer frustration and cancellations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Unpublished/suspended items do not appear in search.
2. Out-of-stock behaviour follows configured rule (hide or show with status).

text: The Platform shall provide a taxonomy governance workflow (propose new categories, approve, deprecate) with audit trail.
shall: The Platform shall provide a taxonomy governance workflow (propose new categories, approve, deprecate) with audit trail.
rationale: Maintains consistent marketplace classification as the platform scales.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Proposed changes require approval by authorized role.
2. All taxonomy changes are logged and versioned.

text: The Platform shall provide a dedicated browsing area for MPC services (postal, logistics, financial services) separate from marketplace goods, with clear service descriptions and ordering flows.
notes: Code-level modification | mapping added; MPC/financial services scope is decision FG-06; roll-up = minimal sufficient set: category carried by the mapped features
shall: The Platform shall provide a dedicated browsing area for MPC services (postal, logistics, financial services) separate from marketplace goods, with clear service descriptions and ordering flows.
rationale: Supports diversification into logistics and financial services referenced in feasibility opportunities.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can browse MPC services catalogue and view service details.
2. Selected services route to an appropriate ordering/request flow.

text: The Platform shall allow Buyers to add goods and services to a shopping cart and modify quantities prior to checkout.
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native cart
shall: The Platform shall allow Buyers to add goods and services to a shopping cart and modify quantities prior to checkout.
rationale: Core e-commerce functionality for marketplace transactions.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can add an item to cart and adjust quantity.
2. Cart recalculates subtotal and total correctly.

text: The Platform shall persist the cart for authenticated users across sessions.
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native persistent cart
shall: The Platform shall persist the cart for authenticated users across sessions.
rationale: Improves conversion under intermittent connectivity and mobile usage.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Items remain in cart after logout/login.
2. Buyer can remove items and cart updates accordingly.

text: The Platform shall validate item availability and pricing at checkout and prevent checkout if validation fails.
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native cart warnings re-check stock and price at checkout
shall: The Platform shall validate item availability and pricing at checkout and prevent checkout if validation fails.
rationale: Prevents failed orders and disputes.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. If item is out of stock or price changed, buyer is prompted to review.
2. Checkout cannot be completed with invalid items.

text: The Platform shall support selection of fulfilment method per order line: delivery to address or pick-up at selected MPC outlet (click-and-collect) where available.
shall: The Platform shall support selection of fulfilment method per order line: delivery to address or pick-up at selected MPC outlet (click-and-collect) where available.
rationale: Aligns with hybrid fulfilment model anchored on post office pick-up.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can select delivery or pickup where the seller/service allows.
2. Order captures selected fulfilment method and outlet/address.

text: The Platform shall compute delivery fees based on configurable rules (weight, distance, service level, pickup vs delivery) and show the fee breakdown at checkout.
shall: The Platform shall compute delivery fees based on configurable rules (weight, distance, service level, pickup vs delivery) and show the fee breakdown at checkout.
rationale: Improves transparency and supports logistics monetization.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Checkout shows delivery fee and total price.
2. Fee calculation rule set is configurable by Admin.

text: The Platform shall allow Buyers to select preferred delivery time window were supported and capture delivery instructions.
shall: The Platform shall allow Buyers to select preferred delivery time window where supported and capture delivery instructions.
rationale: Improves delivery success and customer satisfaction.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can select a time window or enter instructions.
2. Instructions are included in fulfilment task for MPC Ops/partner.

text: The Platform shall present an order summary including items, quantities, taxes/fees, delivery fees, and returns policy acknowledgement before payment.
shall: The Platform shall present an order summary including items, quantities, taxes/fees, delivery fees, and returns policy acknowledgement before payment.
rationale: Supports consumer protection and reduces disputes.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Order summary is displayed prior to payment.
2. Buyer must confirm order summary before proceeding to payment.

text: The Platform shall generate a unique order ID upon checkout initiation and maintain it through payment and fulfilment lifecycle.
shall: The Platform shall generate a unique order ID upon checkout initiation and maintain it through payment and fulfilment lifecycle.
rationale: Enables traceability and integration with postal systems.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Order ID is unique and visible to buyer and seller.
2. Order ID is included in receipts and integration messages.

text: The Platform shall support promo codes and vouchers as configured by Admin, with validation and audit trail.
shall: The Platform shall support promo codes and vouchers as configured by Admin, with validation and audit trail.
rationale: Supports demand generation and marketing.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Valid promo code applies correct discount.
2. Invalid promo code is rejected with message and logged.

text: The Platform shall support split checkout for items from multiple sellers and generate separate fulfilment tasks per seller while presenting a unified checkout experience.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): CHK-004 split checkout covered; CHK-004 is held by PAY-DIRECT / LIC-01 through PAY-010 group payment, and by WF-ENG; P1 single-seller carts until group payment (SPLIT-PAY); as FR-133
shall: The Platform shall support split checkout for items from multiple sellers and generate separate fulfilment tasks per seller while presenting a unified checkout experience.
rationale: Supports marketplace multi-seller operations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can checkout cart with multiple sellers.
2. System generates separate order lines per seller and routes fulfilment accordingly.

text: The Platform shall support cart-level and item-level validation for prohibited combinations (e.g., delivery constraints, pickup-only items).
shall: The Platform shall support cart-level and item-level validation for prohibited combinations (e.g., delivery constraints, pickup-only items).
rationale: Prevents operational failures in fulfilment.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System blocks invalid combinations with clear guidance.
2. Validation rules are configurable by Admin.

text: The Platform shall provide assisted checkout at MPC outlets, enabling an agent to create an order and record payment method for a customer.
shall: The Platform shall provide assisted checkout at MPC outlets, enabling an agent to create an order and record payment method for a customer.
rationale: Supports unbanked and low-literacy users through assisted services.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Agent can create an order on behalf of a customer and capture customer identifier.
2. Assisted checkout records agent and outlet identifier.

text: The Platform shall provide a mechanism to capture and validate delivery addresses using a standardized addressing approach (including landmark/pin/alias fields).
shall: The Platform shall provide a mechanism to capture and validate delivery addresses using a standardized addressing approach (including landmark/pin/alias fields).
rationale: Addresses addressing challenges and improves last-mile reliability.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Address form includes required addressing fields configured by Admin.
2. System validates address completeness and allows geolocation/pin capture where available.

text: The Platform shall provide a checkout failure recovery workflow (resume checkout after payment interruption) with idempotency controls.
shall: The Platform shall provide a checkout failure recovery workflow (resume checkout after payment interruption) with idempotency controls.
rationale: Reduces abandoned transactions under intermittent connectivity.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. If payment is interrupted, buyer can resume checkout and order is not duplicated.
2. System logs recovery events and ensures single final order state.

text: The Platform shall enforce ETCSA consumer controls at checkout, including confirmation message generation within the required timeframe as configured.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): notice and confirmation-timing mechanism covered (CHK-009); ETCSA control list and time limit not stated in source
shall: The Platform shall enforce ETCSA consumer controls at checkout, including confirmation message generation within the required timeframe as configured.
rationale: Supports legal compliance for electronic transactions.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System sends an order confirmation message upon successful order placement.
2. Confirmation content includes order ID, key terms, and contact info as configured.

text: The Platform shall allow Buyers to select payment method at checkout from the configured set (mobile money, bank rails, cards, wallet, cash-on-delivery, assisted payment).
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native payment-method selection; routing belongs to FR-305
shall: The Platform shall allow Buyers to select payment method at checkout from the configured set (mobile money, bank rails, cards, wallet, cash-on-delivery, assisted payment).
rationale: Implements mobile-money-first strategy and inclusive payment options.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Configured payment methods are shown at checkout.
2. Unconfigured payment methods are not available.

text: The Platform shall display and require acknowledgement of returns/refund policy for items/services where applicable during checkout.
shall: The Platform shall display and require acknowledgement of returns/refund policy for items/services where applicable during checkout.
rationale: Builds trust and reduces disputes.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Returns/refund policy is displayed prior to placing order.
2. Acknowledgement is recorded with timestamp.

text: The Platform shall prevent checkout for users with account restrictions (e.g., suspected fraud) according to configurable rules.
shall: The Platform shall prevent checkout for users with account restrictions (e.g., suspected fraud) according to configurable rules.
rationale: Supports fraud controls and customer protection.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Restricted user cannot place order and receives message.
2. Restriction decision is logged with rule identifier.

text: The Platform shall provide an estimated delivery time (EDT) or pickup availability indicator during checkout based on service standards configuration.
shall: The Platform shall provide an estimated delivery time (EDT) or pickup availability indicator during checkout based on service standards configuration.
rationale: Addresses delivery trust concerns and manages expectations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Checkout displays an estimated delivery window for delivery option.
2. If EDT cannot be computed, system shows a standard message and flags for operations review.

text: The Platform shall support creation of separate invoices/receipts per seller and a consolidated receipt for the buyer when applicable.
shall: The Platform shall support creation of separate invoices/receipts per seller and a consolidated receipt for the buyer when applicable.
rationale: Improves transparency for multi-seller checkout and financial reconciliation.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can access consolidated receipt.
2. Sellers access seller-specific invoices for their portion.

text: The Platform shall provide a secure checkout session and prevent tampering with price/totals between client and server.
shall: The Platform shall provide a secure checkout session and prevent tampering with price/totals between client and server.
rationale: Protects against fraud and ensures pricing integrity.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Totals are recalculated server-side and compared to client request.
2. Tampered requests are rejected and logged.

text: The Platform shall allow configuration of minimum order values and fee thresholds (e.g., free pickup) per policy.
shall: The Platform shall allow configuration of minimum order values and fee thresholds (e.g., free pickup) per policy.
rationale: Supports sustainable revenue mix and operational policies.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure thresholds and effective dates.
2. Checkout enforces thresholds correctly.

text: The Platform shall provide a 'save for later' feature for cart items.
shall: The Platform shall provide a 'save for later' feature for cart items.
rationale: Supports mobile-first shopping behaviour and intermittent connectivity.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can move item from cart to save-for-later list.
2. Saved items can be moved back to cart.

text: The Platform shall support buyer-side selection of preferred pickup identification method (e.g., order code, QR code) and present it at pickup.
shall: The Platform shall support buyer-side selection of preferred pickup identification method (e.g., order code, QR code) and present it at pickup.
rationale: Improves pickup efficiency at outlets and reduces fraud at collection.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Platform displays pickup code/QR for eligible orders.
2. Outlet agent can validate code/QR against order record.

text: The Platform shall allow guest users to browse listings and initiate checkout, and shall require account creation or authentication before payment is executed.
shall: The Platform shall allow guest users to browse listings and initiate checkout, and shall require account creation or authentication before payment is executed.
rationale: Balances low-friction discovery with secure transactional processing.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Guest can add items to cart and proceed to checkout steps until authentication gate.
2. Payment step is blocked until user authenticates or registers.

text: The Platform shall integrate with TNM Mpamba mobile money to initiate and confirm payments for orders and services.
shall: The Platform shall integrate with TNM Mpamba mobile money to initiate and confirm payments for orders and services.
rationale: Implements mobile-money-first payment strategy for Malawi context.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. A payment can be initiated to Mpamba and receives a success/fail confirmation.
2. Successful payment updates order status to 'Paid' and generates receipt.

text: The Platform shall integrate with Airtel Money to initiate and confirm payments for orders and services.
shall: The Platform shall integrate with Airtel Money to initiate and confirm payments for orders and services.
rationale: Implements mobile-money-first payment strategy for Malawi context.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. A payment can be initiated to Airtel Money and receives a success/fail confirmation.
2. Successful payment updates order status to 'Paid' and generates receipt.

text: The Platform shall support bank transfer / bank rails payments where integrated, including payment reference generation.
shall: The Platform shall support bank transfer / bank rails payments where integrated, including payment reference generation.
rationale: Supports inclusive payment options beyond mobile money.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Platform generates a unique payment reference for bank payments.
2. Payment confirmation updates order status once received from bank integration or manual verification workflow.

text: The Platform shall support card payments (debit/credit) where a payment gateway is selected, including PCI-DSS aligned handling (tokenization).
shall: The Platform shall support card payments (debit/credit) where a payment gateway is selected, including PCI-DSS aligned handling (tokenization).
rationale: Expands payment options and supports future scalability.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Card payments are processed via gateway without storing raw PAN on Platform.
2. Gateway token is stored and can be reused if enabled by purchaser policy.

text: The Platform shall support digital wallet payments (e.g. PostPay wallet) if enabled by Purchaser, including wallet top-up and wallet balance checks.
notes: Code-level modification | FG-06 (MPC/financial services); Inference: stored-value wallet may need e-money licensing in Malawi — not stated in source
shall: The Platform shall support digital wallet payments (e.g., PostPay wallet) if enabled by Purchaser, including wallet top-up and wallet balance checks.
rationale: Supports feasibility use case for wallet and payments engine.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can view wallet balance.
2. User can pay with wallet for eligible orders and balance decreases accordingly.

text: The Platform shall support assisted cash payments at MPC outlets for orders initiated online, with secure payment reference and reconciliation.
shall: The Platform shall support assisted cash payments at MPC outlets for orders initiated online, with secure payment reference and reconciliation.
rationale: Enables inclusive payments for unbanked users using MPC footprint.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Agent can accept cash and record payment against order using reference.
2. Order status updates to Paid and cash collection is included in reconciliation report.

text: The Platform shall support cash-on-delivery (COD) as a configurable payment option per seller/item and geography.
shall: The Platform shall support cash-on-delivery (COD) as a configurable payment option per seller/item and geography.
rationale: Supports feasibility trust and adoption measures for early-stage marketplace.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can select COD for eligible items/areas.
2. COD orders are flagged for operations and marked Paid only after delivery confirmation or cash collection record.

text: The Platform shall support split payments and fee splitting among stakeholders (seller payout, MPC logistics fee, platform commission) as per configured rules.
notes: Code-level modification | Decisions PAY-DIRECT names FR-133 (payment-service licensing)
shall: The Platform shall support split payments and fee splitting among stakeholders (seller payout, MPC logistics fee, platform commission) as per configured rules.
rationale: Implements marketplace revenue mix and settlement needs.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. For a multi-party order, system computes splits per rule set.
2. Settlement statement shows splits and payout amounts.

text: The Platform shall record payment status lifecycle (Initiated, Pending, Successful, Failed, Reversed) and link it to the order lifecycle.
shall: The Platform shall record payment status lifecycle (Initiated, Pending, Successful, Failed, Reversed) and link it to the order lifecycle.
rationale: Enables reliable transaction processing and dispute handling.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Payment status transitions are recorded with timestamps.
2. Order status updates are consistent with payment status rules.

text: The Platform shall implement idempotency for payment initiation to prevent duplicate charges under retry conditions.
shall: The Platform shall implement idempotency for payment initiation to prevent duplicate charges under retry conditions.
rationale: Reduces risk of double-charging in intermittent connectivity contexts.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Repeated payment initiation requests with same idempotency key do not create multiple charges.
2. System logs idempotent handling outcomes.

text: The Platform shall generate and deliver payment confirmations/receipts to users via configured channels after successful payment.
shall: The Platform shall generate and deliver payment confirmations/receipts to users via configured channels after successful payment.
rationale: Supports ETCSA confirmations and trust building.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Receipt is sent after successful payment within a configurable time window.
2. Receipt includes payment reference and order ID.

text: The Platform shall provide automated reconciliation reports comparing payment provider transactions with Platform orders and settlements.
shall: The Platform shall provide automated reconciliation reports comparing payment provider transactions with Platform orders and settlements.
rationale: Supports financial controls and integration with accounting systems.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Reconciliation report can be generated by date range and payment method.
2. Report highlights unmatched or exception transactions.

text: The Platform shall integrate with SAGE 200 to post summarized financial transactions and support reconciliation workflows.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): summarised posting covered (INT-006); summary rules not received (MG-09)
shall: The Platform shall integrate with SAGE 200 to post summarized financial transactions and support reconciliation workflows.
rationale: Supports integration of e-commerce revenues/costs with finance system.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Interface specification exists and is implemented for agreed transaction types.
2. Demonstration of posting at least one transaction batch and confirming receipt in SAGE 200.

text: The Platform shall provide configuration for payment fees (provider fees, platform fees) and support versioned fee schedules.
shall: The Platform shall provide configuration for payment fees (provider fees, platform fees) and support versioned fee schedules.
rationale: Enables transparent pricing and financial reporting.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure fee schedules with effective dates.
2. Order totals reflect correct fee schedule.

text: The Platform shall support refund processing to the original payment method (where supported) and record refund lifecycle and references.
shall: The Platform shall support refund processing to the original payment method (where supported) and record refund lifecycle and references.
rationale: Supports returns and dispute resolution.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Refund can be initiated and its status tracked (pending/success/fail).
2. Refund reference is stored and visible in order history.

text: The Platform shall support partial refunds at item level and proportional fee adjustments.
notes: Code-level modification | closed by PAY-016 amended, PAY-015 mapped; Proportional fee adjustment on partial refunds not described
shall: The Platform shall support partial refunds at item level and proportional fee adjustments.
rationale: Supports partial returns and customer satisfaction.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System can calculate partial refund amounts including fees/taxes.
2. Settlement statements reflect adjustments correctly.

text: The Platform shall provide chargeback and dispute tracking for card payments where applicable.
shall: The Platform shall provide chargeback and dispute tracking for card payments where applicable.
rationale: Supports financial controls and consumer protection.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Chargeback events can be recorded and linked to order/payment.
2. Reporting includes chargeback counts and amounts.

text: The Platform shall support payment risk controls (velocity checks, suspicious transaction flags) configurable by Admin.
shall: The Platform shall support payment risk controls (velocity checks, suspicious transaction flags) configurable by Admin.
rationale: Supports fraud prevention and AML/CFT controls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure at least two risk rules.
2. Transactions triggering rules are flagged and routed for review.

text: The Platform shall provide a payments operations console for authorized users to view transaction logs, exceptions, and manual interventions with audit trail.
shall: The Platform shall provide a payments operations console for authorized users to view transaction logs, exceptions, and manual interventions with audit trail.
rationale: Enables controlled operational handling of payment exceptions.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Authorized user can search payments by order ID/reference and view statuses.
2. Manual actions require reason codes and are logged.

text: The Platform shall support settlement scheduling (daily/weekly) to sellers based on configurable payout cycles.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): SEL-017 settlement scheduling covered; SEL-017 is held by PAY-DIRECT / LIC-01 through PAY-010, and by WF-ENG (the Decisions, gaps and open items register §2); as FR-133
shall: The Platform shall support settlement scheduling (daily/weekly) to sellers based on configurable payout cycles.
rationale: Supports predictable seller payouts and trust.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure payout cycles.
2. System generates settlement runs and statements accordingly.

text: The Platform shall provide integration hooks for government fee collection and remittance workflows for e-government services.
shall: The Platform shall provide integration hooks for government fee collection and remittance workflows for e-government services.
rationale: Supports e-government service payments and integration.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. For an e-Gov service, payment is captured and remittance report is generated for the agency.
2. Agency remittance report includes service identifiers and payment references.

text: The Platform shall support configurable taxation rules for fees and commissions where required and generate tax reports.
shall: The Platform shall support configurable taxation rules for fees and commissions where required and generate tax reports.
rationale: Supports compliance and financial reporting.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure tax rate rules.
2. Tax report can be generated for a period and exported.

text: The Platform shall encrypt payment-related data at rest and in transit, and shall never store sensitive card data in cleartext.
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration) | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: encryption at rest is a database/hosting function (for example transparent data encryption) outside nopCommerce; SEC-001 covers transport and password hashing
shall: The Platform shall encrypt payment-related data at rest and in transit, and shall never store sensitive card data in cleartext.
rationale: Protects customer data and supports cybersecurity program.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Inspection confirms TLS is used for payment interactions.
2. Inspection confirms no cleartext sensitive card data stored in database/logs.

text: The Platform shall provide daily payment reconciliation exports in a format suitable for upload into finance systems if direct API integration is not available.
shall: The Platform shall provide daily payment reconciliation exports in a format suitable for upload into finance systems if direct API integration is not available.
rationale: Supports pragmatic integration where APIs are limited.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Export file is generated per day/per payment method.
2. Export includes required fields (date, amount, reference, status) and is validated for completeness.

text: The Platform shall provide a payment status page that clearly communicates next steps for pending or failed payments, including retry and support options.
shall: The Platform shall provide a payment status page that clearly communicates next steps for pending or failed payments, including retry and support options.
rationale: Improves user experience and reduces support calls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Pending payments show clear status and last update time.
2. Failed payments present retry option and support contact.

text: The Platform shall provide buyers with an order history view including status, items, totals, and tracking reference(s).
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native order history with shipments and tracking numbers
shall: The Platform shall provide buyers with an order history view including status, items, totals, and tracking reference(s).
rationale: Improves transparency and repeat usage.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can view all orders with filters by date/status.
2. Order detail shows items, totals, and fulfilment method.

text: The Platform shall provide sellers with an order management dashboard to view incoming orders and required actions (accept, pack, handover).
shall: The Platform shall provide sellers with an order management dashboard to view incoming orders and required actions (accept, pack, handover).
rationale: Enables efficient seller fulfilment and reduces delivery delays.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can view new orders and acknowledge/accept them.
2. Seller can update order fulfilment milestones as allowed.

text: The Platform shall implement an order status model with defined states (e.g., Created, Awaiting Payment, Paid, Processing, Shipped, Ready for Pickup, Delivered, Completed, Cancelled, Returned, Refunded).
shall: The Platform shall implement an order status model with defined states (e.g., Created, Awaiting Payment, Paid, Processing, Shipped, Ready for Pickup, Delivered, Completed, Cancelled, Returned, Refunded).
rationale: Enables consistent workflows and integrations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Order transitions follow defined rules and invalid transitions are blocked.
2. Order status updates are timestamped and auditable.

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to cancel an order prior to fulfilment start according to configurable policy.
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to cancel an order prior to fulfilment start according to configurable policy.
rationale: Supports consumer control and reduces disputes.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can request cancellation when order is in eligible state.
2. System applies cancellation rules and updates status with reason.

text: The Platform shall allow sellers to cancel or reject an order under defined conditions (e.g., out of stock), with mandatory reason code.
shall: The Platform shall allow sellers to cancel or reject an order under defined conditions (e.g., out of stock), with mandatory reason code.
rationale: Supports operational realities while maintaining transparency.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can cancel/reject in allowed states only.
2. Buyer receives cancellation notification with reason code.

text: The Platform shall provide an admin console for order search and intervention, with all interventions requiring reason codes and audit logs.
shall: The Platform shall provide an admin console for order search and intervention, with all interventions requiring reason codes and audit logs.
rationale: Supports controlled operational exception handling.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can search orders by order ID, buyer, seller, or tracking reference.
2. Interventions are logged with user, time, and reason.

text: The Platform shall generate packing slips and shipping labels for seller fulfilment tasks according to configured templates.
shall: The Platform shall generate packing slips and shipping labels for seller fulfilment tasks according to configured templates.
rationale: Supports standardized fulfilment processes.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can download packing slip and label for eligible orders.
2. Label includes required identifiers and barcodes.

text: The Platform shall support partial fulfilment where an order contains multiple items and some are unavailable, with buyer notification and approval workflow as configured.
shall: The Platform shall support partial fulfilment where an order contains multiple items and some are unavailable, with buyer notification and approval workflow as configured.
rationale: Reduces full-order cancellations and improves service continuity.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can mark item as unavailable and propose partial fulfilment.
2. Buyer can approve or reject the partial fulfilment proposal.

text: The Platform shall send order confirmation notifications after order placement and status change notifications thereafter.
shall: The Platform shall send order confirmation notifications after order placement and status change notifications thereafter.
rationale: Improves transparency and supports ETCSA confirmations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer receives confirmation notification for order placement.
2. Buyer receives notifications for at least three key status changes.

text: The Platform shall send sellers notifications for new orders, payment confirmation, and fulfilment deadlines.
shall: The Platform shall send sellers notifications for new orders, payment confirmation, and fulfilment deadlines.
rationale: Improves seller responsiveness and on-time fulfilment.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller receives notification for new order within configured time window.
2. Fulfilment deadline reminders are sent per policy.

text: The Platform shall allocate fulfilment tasks between MPC and seller/partner based on configured fulfilment model (merchant-fulfilled, MPC-fulfilled, third-party).
shall: The Platform shall allocate fulfilment tasks between MPC and seller/partner based on configured fulfilment model (merchant-fulfilled, MPC-fulfilled, third-party).
rationale: Supports hybrid logistics model and scalability.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. For each order, system assigns fulfilment model based on item/seller settings.
2. Assigned model is visible to stakeholders and used in workflows.

text: The Platform shall provide an operational view of orders requiring pickup, sorting, dispatch, and last-mile delivery actions.
shall: The Platform shall provide an operational view of orders requiring pickup, sorting, dispatch, and last-mile delivery actions.
rationale: Enables integration of e-commerce with postal operations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Operations user can view a queue of tasks by outlet/hub and status.
2. Tasks can be filtered by due date and service level.

text: The Platform shall support unique shipment identifiers linked to order lines and tracking references compatible with UPU S10 where applicable.
shall: The Platform shall support unique shipment identifiers linked to order lines and tracking references compatible with UPU S10 where applicable.
rationale: Supports interoperability for domestic and cross-border shipments.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Shipment ID and tracking reference are generated per shipment.
2. For cross-border eligible shipments, tracking reference follows UPU S10 format as configured.

text: The Platform shall provide digital proof of delivery/collection confirmation (e.g., signature capture, OTP, or scan) and store it in the order record.
shall: The Platform shall provide digital proof of delivery/collection confirmation (e.g., signature capture, OTP, or scan) and store it in the order record.
rationale: Builds trust and supports dispute resolution.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Proof of delivery is captured for delivered/collected orders.
2. Proof is retrievable by authorized users and audit logged.

text: The Platform shall allow configuration of order cut-off times and fulfilment SLAs per service level.
shall: The Platform shall allow configuration of order cut-off times and fulfilment SLAs per service level.
rationale: Supports predictable delivery promises and operational planning.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure cut-off times and SLAs.
2. System enforces cut-off times and flags SLA breaches.

text: The Platform shall provide an event-driven integration mechanism to notify PostGlobal and other systems of order and shipment events.
shall: The Platform shall provide an event-driven integration mechanism to notify PostGlobal and other systems of order and shipment events.
rationale: Supports seamless integration with core postal systems and tracking.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Integration events are published for key milestones (paid, shipped, delivered).
2. Events are retried on failure and logged.

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to modify delivery address/instructions before dispatch subject to configurable rules. The platform shall define the number of days MPC will store an item at no cost, beyond which configurable daily warehousing charges shall apply.
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to modify delivery address/instructions before dispatch subject to configurable rules. The platform shall define the number of days MPC will store an item at no cost, beyond which configurable daily warehousing charges shall apply.
rationale: Improves delivery success and customer satisfaction.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can request address change when order in eligible state.
2. System updates fulfilment task and logs change history.

text: The Platform shall provide seller-side order batching and printing tools (pick list, packing list) for processing multiple orders.
notes: Code-level modification | Seller-side batching: PRD-LOG-009 described as warehouse function
shall: The Platform shall provide seller-side order batching and printing tools (pick list, packing list) for processing multiple orders.
rationale: Improves seller operational efficiency.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can select multiple orders and print batch documents.
2. Batch document includes order IDs, items, quantities.

text: The Platform shall support order holds for suspected fraud or compliance review, preventing fulfilment until release.
shall: The Platform shall support order holds for suspected fraud or compliance review, preventing fulfilment until release.
rationale: Supports fraud management and AML/CFT controls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Order can be placed on hold by authorized user or rule trigger.
2. Hold reason is recorded and fulfilment actions are blocked until release.

text: The Platform shall support configuration of seller fulfilment deadlines and automatic cancellations/penalties for non-compliance as per marketplace policy.
shall: The Platform shall support configuration of seller fulfilment deadlines and automatic cancellations/penalties for non-compliance as per marketplace policy.
rationale: Improves reliability and trust for buyers.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can set deadlines and penalties.
2. System applies actions when deadlines exceeded and logs outcomes.

text: The Platform shall provide a digital invoice that includes seller identity, MPC service fees, and tax components as configured.
shall: The Platform shall provide a digital invoice that includes seller identity, MPC service fees, and tax components as configured.
rationale: Supports transparency and compliance.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Invoice includes required fields and can be downloaded.
2. Invoice values match the order totals and splits.

text: The Platform shall provide configurable order numbering formats and prefixes to support separation of lots/services and reporting.
notes: Reusable — configuration | roll-up = minimal sufficient set: native CustomOrderNumberMask covers formats and prefixes; zero-padding is a product choice (ORD-007)
shall: The Platform shall provide configurable order numbering formats and prefixes to support separation of lots/services and reporting.
rationale: Supports operational reporting and integration mapping.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure order number format (prefix, year, sequence).
2. Order numbers generated follow configured format.

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to reorder past orders (repeat purchase) with availability and price revalidation.
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to reorder past orders (repeat purchase) with availability and price revalidation.
rationale: Supports repeat usage and convenience.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can select a past order and add items to cart.
2. System revalidates current price and stock before checkout.

text: The Platform shall provide an order export function for authorized users with filters (date, status, seller) to support offline analysis and statutory reporting.
shall: The Platform shall provide an order export function for authorized users with filters (date, status, seller) to support offline analysis and statutory reporting.
rationale: Supports governance and reporting needs.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can export order dataset in CSV format.
2. Export respects RBAC and excludes restricted fields.

text: The Platform shall maintain immutable audit logs for all order state transitions and key order field changes.
shall: The Platform shall maintain immutable audit logs for all order state transitions and key order field changes.
rationale: Supports compliance, dispute resolution, and security monitoring.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Audit log entries cannot be modified by standard admin users.
2. Audit log contains old value, new value, actor, timestamp.

text: The Platform shall integrate with a logistics management module to create fulfilment tasks for pickup, sorting, dispatch, and delivery/collection.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall integrate with a logistics management module to create fulfilment tasks for pickup, sorting, dispatch, and delivery/collection.
rationale: Enables end-to-end delivery operations aligned with postal workflows.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Fulfilment task is created for each order requiring logistics.
2. Tasks include required fields (pickup, destination, service level) and are visible to MPC Ops.

text: The Platform shall allow MPC Ops to schedule parcel pick-up from sellers and record pickup confirmation.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall allow MPC Ops to schedule parcel pick-up from sellers and record pickup confirmation.
rationale: Supports 3PL and seller-collection logistics model.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Ops user can schedule pickup for eligible sellers/orders.
2. Pickup confirmation updates shipment status and is logged.

text: The Platform shall support drop-off processing at post offices/agencies, including scanning and acceptance of parcels for delivery.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall support drop-off processing at post offices/agencies, including scanning and acceptance of parcels for delivery.
rationale: Leverages MPC outlets for logistics operations and click-and-collect.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Outlet agent can scan a parcel and accept it into system.
2. System records acceptance location and time.

text: The Platform shall support route planning/dispatch lists for last-mile delivery tasks with ability to mark delivery attempts.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall support route planning/dispatch lists for last-mile delivery tasks with ability to mark delivery attempts.
rationale: Improves efficiency and delivery success.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Delivery runs can be generated for a date/outlet.
2. Driver can record delivery attempt outcomes and capture reason codes.
bidderNote: (Requires External Logistics Integration and Custom Last-Mile Delivery Module)

text: The Platform shall support multiple delivery partners (MPC fleet, private couriers) with configurable partner assignment rules.
shall: The Platform shall support multiple delivery partners (MPC fleet, private couriers) with configurable partner assignment rules.
rationale: Supports scalability and improved last-mile coverage.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure delivery partners and assignment rules.
2. Orders are routed to correct partner per rules and partner receives task data.

text: The Platform shall support warehouse/fulfilment center operations where enabled (pick, pack, stage, dispatch) for MPC-fulfilled items.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall support warehouse/fulfilment centre operations where enabled (pick, pack, stage, dispatch) for MPC-fulfilled items.
rationale: Supports 3PL fulfilment use case.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Warehouse user can create pick list and confirm pick/pack actions.
2. Inventory adjustments are recorded and auditable.

text: The Platform shall compute and present estimated delivery times based on service standards, connectivity constraints, and operational cut-offs.
shall: The Platform shall compute and present estimated delivery times based on service standards, connectivity constraints, and operational cut-offs.
rationale: Improves transparency and trust in delivery promises.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. EDT calculation uses configured service standards.
2. When standards are missing, system flags the configuration gap.

text: The Platform shall support creation and printing of standardized shipping labels and barcodes compatible with postal scanning processes.
shall: The Platform shall support creation and printing of standardized shipping labels and barcodes compatible with postal scanning processes.
rationale: Enables consistent processing at sorting hubs and outlets.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Label includes tracking number/barcode and routing information.
2. Label template can be configured and printed.

text: The Platform shall allow configuration of delivery service levels (standard, express, pickup) and corresponding pricing and SLAs.
shall: The Platform shall allow configuration of delivery service levels (standard, express, pickup) and corresponding pricing and SLAs.
rationale: Supports service differentiation and revenue model.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure service levels and prices.
2. Checkout and fulfilment apply correct service level attributes.

text: The Platform shall support address validation and geocoding where available, and store geolocation coordinates to support last-mile routing.
shall: The Platform shall support address validation and geocoding where available, and store geolocation coordinates to support last-mile routing.
rationale: Improves delivery success in areas with weak addressing.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Address can include geolocation coordinates if captured.
2. Routing view can display geolocation on map where available.
bidderNote: (Custom Module with External Geocoding Services and Logistics Integration)

text: The Platform shall support incident reporting for logistics (lost parcel, damaged parcel, delayed) with escalation workflows.
shall: The Platform shall support incident reporting for logistics (lost parcel, damaged parcel, delayed) with escalation workflows.
rationale: Supports accountability and customer service.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Ops user can log a logistics incident with category and description.
2. Incident is linked to shipment and visible to customer support.

text: The Platform shall support proof-of-delivery capture, including time, location, recipient acknowledgement method, and media attachment where applicable.
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration) | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): LOG-032 criteria held by FG-06 (postal operations scope) and PAID-STUB
shall: The Platform shall support proof-of-delivery capture, including time, location, recipient acknowledgement method, and media attachment where applicable.
rationale: Supports dispute resolution and trust.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. POD fields are captured and stored for delivered shipments.
2. POD is retrievable by authorized users and linked to order.

text: The Platform shall support pickup point management including operating hours, capacity flags, and temporary closure status.
shall: The Platform shall support pickup point management including operating hours, capacity flags, and temporary closure status.
rationale: Ensures accurate pickup options and reduces failed collections.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin/Ops can update pickup point status and hours.
2. Checkout and notifications reflect pickup point status changes.
bidderNote: (Custom module on top of the pick-up point module)

text: The Platform shall support reverse logistics workflows for returns, including return pickup/drop-off and routing back to seller/warehouse.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): RET-003 criteria held by T-MISS (Table 10 return shipping models not provided)
shall: The Platform shall support reverse logistics workflows for returns, including return pickup/drop-off and routing back to seller/warehouse.

text: The Platform shall support cross-border shipment workflows including generation of customs declarations and exchange of customs data via CDS where integrated.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System captures customs-required data for eligible orders.

text: The Platform shall support integration with IPS for international mail tracking where required and expose tracking information to users.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Tracking events from IPS are ingested and displayed on shipment tracking page.
2. Exceptions are logged and retried.

text: The Platform shall support hub-and-spoke sorting operations with scanning events at each handover point.

shall: The Platform shall support hub-and-spoke sorting operations with scanning events at each handover point.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Scan events can be recorded at pickup, hub arrival, hub departure, delivery.
2. Each scan records location and timestamp.

text: The Platform shall provide delivery status exception handling for unreachable addresses (address correction workflow, redelivery scheduling, return-to-sender).
shall: The Platform shall provide delivery status exception handling for unreachable addresses (address correction workflow, redelivery scheduling, return-to-sender).
