clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. When delivery attempt fails, system prompts buyer to correct address or reschedule.
2. Exceptions are logged and visible to ops and customer support.

text: The Platform shall support cash collection handling for COD deliveries including reconciliation of cash collected to order and delivery run.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall support cash collection handling for COD deliveries including reconciliation of cash collected to order and delivery run.
rationale: Supports COD option and financial controls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Delivery agent can record COD cash collected per order.
2. Daily reconciliation report shows COD collected vs expected.

text: The Platform shall support configurable delivery proof methods (signature, OTP, QR scan) selectable per service level.
shall: The Platform shall support configurable delivery proof methods (signature, OTP, QR scan) selectable per service level.
rationale: Provides flexible security and user convenience.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure allowed proof methods per service.
2. Delivery completion requires an allowed proof method and is recorded.

text: The Platform shall provide a logistics performance dashboard (on-time delivery, delivery success rate, average transit time) for MPC Ops and management.
shall: The Platform shall provide a logistics performance dashboard (on-time delivery, delivery success rate, average transit time) for MPC Ops and management.
rationale: Supports governance and continuous improvement.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Dashboard shows KPIs by period and location/hub.
2. KPIs can be exported and include drill-down by service level.

text: The Platform shall support serviceability rules that determine whether delivery is available for a given buyer location/outlet and show available options accordingly.
shall: The Platform shall support serviceability rules that determine whether delivery is available for a given buyer location/outlet and show available options accordingly.
rationale: Prevents orders to non-serviceable areas and manages expectations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. For a given address, system returns available delivery services.
2. Unavailable services are hidden or disabled with explanation.

text: The Platform shall support configuration of pickup and delivery fees and revenue share models for logistics partners where applicable.
shall: The Platform shall support configuration of pickup and delivery fees and revenue share models for logistics partners where applicable.
rationale: Supports revenue mix and partner management.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure partner fee share rules.
2. Settlement reports reflect partner shares.

text: The Platform shall provide a mechanism to generate daily dispatch manifests for handover to linehaul/transport operators.
notes: Code-level modification | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall provide a mechanism to generate daily dispatch manifests for handover to linehaul/transport operators.
rationale: Improves operational control for intercity transport.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Manifest can be generated for selected route/outlet and date.
2. Manifest includes shipment IDs, quantities, and handover signatures/acknowledgements.

text: The Platform shall support integration with an addressing / digital postcode or alias system if adopted, and include it in labels and tracking.
shall: The Platform shall support integration with an addressing / digital postcode or alias system if adopted, and include it in labels and tracking.
rationale: Supports feasibility recommendation for addressing solution.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. If alias system is configured, orders store alias and include it on label.
2. Search and tracking can retrieve orders by alias.

text: The Platform shall provide shipment tracking to buyers using tracking number and/or order ID.
shall: The Platform shall provide shipment tracking to buyers using tracking number and/or order ID.
rationale: Improves transparency and trust in delivery.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can access tracking page from order details.
2. Tracking page displays current status and key events.

text: The Platform shall send proactive delivery status notifications (e.g., shipped, out for delivery, ready for pickup, delivered) via configured channels.
shall: The Platform shall send proactive delivery status notifications (e.g., shipped, out for delivery, ready for pickup, delivered) via configured channels.
rationale: Improves customer experience and reduces inquiries.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Notifications are triggered on defined shipment events.
2. User receives notifications in selected channels (SMS/email/in-app) where available.

text: The Platform shall support tracking event capture from multiple sources (MPC scans, partner courier updates, IPS/CDS where integrated).
shall: The Platform shall support tracking event capture from multiple sources (MPC scans, partner courier updates, IPS/CDS where integrated).
rationale: Supports hybrid logistics operations and cross-border readiness.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System can ingest events from at least two sources in demo environment.
2. Events are normalized to a common status model.

text: The Platform shall provide scanning interfaces for recording track-and-trace events at pickup, hub, and delivery points.
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration) | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall provide scanning interfaces for recording track-and-trace events at pickup, hub, and delivery points.
rationale: Enables end-to-end track-and-trace recommended in feasibility study.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Ops user can record scan event with shipment ID and location.
2. Scan events update tracking status and are visible to buyer.

text: The Platform shall support UPU S10 tracking number standard formatting and validation for international shipments where applicable.
shall: The Platform shall support UPU S10 tracking number standard formatting and validation for international shipments where applicable.
rationale: Ensures interoperability for international parcels.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System validates S10 format for configured shipments.
2. S10 number is included on shipping labels and tracking pages.
bidderNote: (Custom module to handle external Carrier/Postal Integrations)

text: The Platform shall provide pickup readiness notifications and include pickup instructions (outlet address, hours, required ID/code).
shall: The Platform shall provide pickup readiness notifications and include pickup instructions (outlet address, hours, required ID/code).
rationale: Improves pickup experience and reduces failed collections.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. When status changes to 'Ready for Pickup', notification is sent.
2. Notification includes outlet details and pickup code.

text: The Platform shall provide delivery attempt notifications including reason codes (unreachable, not at home, address issue) and rescheduling options.
notes: Code-level modification | Rescheduling options not in PRD-TRK-012
shall: The Platform shall provide delivery attempt notifications including reason codes (unreachable, not at home, address issue) and rescheduling options.
rationale: Addresses last-mile challenges and improves completion rates.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer receives attempt notification with reason code.
2. Buyer can select reschedule option or update address where policy allows.

text: The Platform shall provide a tracking timeline view showing event history with timestamps and locations where available.
shall: The Platform shall provide a tracking timeline view showing event history with timestamps and locations where available.
rationale: Supports user trust and transparency.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Timeline displays at least event type, timestamp, and location label.
2. Timeline is consistent with backend event logs.

text: The Platform shall provide an exception status handling mechanism for delayed or missing scans and flag them for ops review.
shall: The Platform shall provide an exception status handling mechanism for delayed or missing scans and flag them for ops review.
rationale: Improves tracking reliability and operations oversight.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. System flags shipments with missing scans beyond configured threshold.
2. Ops can view exception queue and take corrective action.

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to subscribe/unsubscribe to tracking updates per order.
notes: Code-level modification | closed by TRK-006 amended; Per-order subscribe/unsubscribe not described (TRK-006 is per message type/channel)
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to subscribe/unsubscribe to tracking updates per order.
rationale: Reduces unwanted messages and supports consumer controls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can toggle subscription for a given order.
2. System respects subscription state for notifications.

text: The Platform shall provide customer support users with a consolidated view of order, payment, and tracking status for a given customer query.
shall: The Platform shall provide customer support users with a consolidated view of order, payment, and tracking status for a given customer query.
rationale: Reduces resolution time and improves service quality.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support agent can search by order ID/tracking number/phone number.
2. View displays key statuses and history for payment and tracking.

text: The Platform shall support notification templates with configurable content for each event type and channel.
shall: The Platform shall support notification templates with configurable content for each event type and channel.
rationale: Allows compliance-aligned messaging and consistent user communication.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can edit templates and preview output.
2. Templates support variables (order ID, tracking number, outlet name).

text: The Platform shall provide notification delivery reports (sent, delivered, failed) by channel and event type.
shall: The Platform shall provide notification delivery reports (sent, delivered, failed) by channel and event type.
rationale: Enables monitoring of communication effectiveness and costs.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Report is available by date range and channel.
2. Failed deliveries are shown with error codes where available.

text: The Platform shall support multi-channel notifications including SMS and email, and in-app notifications where channels are enabled.
shall: The Platform shall support multi-channel notifications including SMS and email, and in-app notifications where channels are enabled.
rationale: Supports mobile-first reach and platform communications.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. At least two channels are demonstrated end-to-end.
2. Channel availability is configurable by Admin.

text: The Platform shall record notification events and link them to order/shipment records for audit.
shall: The Platform shall record notification events and link them to order/shipment records for audit.
rationale: Supports dispute resolution and compliance.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Each notification is logged with timestamp, recipient, channel, and template ID.
2. Log entries are retrievable for audit and customer support.

text: The Platform shall provide estimated pickup deadline reminders and uncollected parcel escalation notifications.
shall: The Platform shall provide estimated pickup deadline reminders and uncollected parcel escalation notifications.
rationale: Improves operational efficiency and reduces storage constraints at outlets.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Reminder is sent before configured pickup deadline.
2. Escalation notification is sent when deadline passed and parcel not collected.

text: The Platform shall support API-based event subscription (webhooks) for sellers and partners to receive order/shipment updates.
shall: The Platform shall support API-based event subscription (webhooks) for sellers and partners to receive order/shipment updates.
rationale: Supports scalable integration with seller systems and partners.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Webhook can be registered with authentication and event types.
2. At least one event is delivered to registered webhook endpoint in demo.

text: The Platform shall provide sellers with shipment tracking visibility for their orders, including handover and delivery events.
shall: The Platform shall provide sellers with shipment tracking visibility for their orders, including handover and delivery events.
rationale: Improves seller customer service and reduces inquiries.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can view tracking events for orders they sold.
2. Seller can filter shipments by status.

text: The Platform shall provide configuration for notification suppression rules (quiet hours, rate limits) to manage user experience.
shall: The Platform shall provide configuration for notification suppression rules (quiet hours, rate limits) to manage user experience.
rationale: Improves communication quality and reduces spam risk.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure quiet hours and rate limits.
2. Notifications are suppressed/queued according to rules.

text: The Platform shall provide a secure sharing mechanism for tracking updates with third parties (e.g., recipient) without exposing full account details.
shall: The Platform shall provide a secure sharing mechanism for tracking updates with third parties (e.g., recipient) without exposing full account details.
rationale: Supports recipient notifications and privacy.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can share a tracking link/token with a recipient.
2. Recipient can view tracking but cannot view buyer personal information beyond what is required.

text: The Platform shall maintain a standardized event dictionary for tracking statuses and provide mappings for external systems (PostGlobal, IPS).
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration) | mapping added
shall: The Platform shall maintain a standardized event dictionary for tracking statuses and provide mappings for external systems (PostGlobal, IPS).
rationale: Ensures consistent tracking language across systems and channels.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Event dictionary is documented.
2. Mapping table exists and is used in integrations.

text: The Platform shall provide real-time status refresh and manual refresh controls for tracking pages.
shall: The Platform shall provide real-time status refresh and manual refresh controls for tracking pages.
rationale: Improves usability under variable connectivity.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Tracking page can be refreshed and updates status if new events exist.
2. Under no-new-event condition, system displays last update time.

text: The Platform shall provide an outage/degradation notification mechanism to inform users when tracking updates are delayed due to system issues.
shall: The Platform shall provide an outage/degradation notification mechanism to inform users when tracking updates are delayed due to system issues.
rationale: Manages user expectations and reduces support volume.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can publish a service message.
2. Tracking pages display service message during incident and log when shown.

text: The Platform shall support capturing delivery agent identifiers and device identifiers for tracking events for accountability.
notes: Cannot be done in nopCommerce (external system + integration) | Postal-operations scope: decision FG-06 (O-2)
shall: The Platform shall support capturing delivery agent identifiers and device identifiers for tracking events for accountability.
rationale: Supports operational governance and dispute resolution.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Tracking event records include agent ID and device ID for events created via delivery app.
2. Records are retrievable in audit reports.

text: The Platform shall support tracking event retention and archival rules consistent with compliance requirements and operational needs.
shall: The Platform shall support tracking event retention and archival rules consistent with compliance requirements and operational needs.
rationale: Supports compliance and performance of tracking history.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure retention period or archival policy.
2. Archived events remain retrievable for audit upon request.

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to initiate a return request for eligible items within the configured return window.
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to initiate a return request for eligible items within the configured return window.
rationale: Implements buyer protection and hybrid returns policy.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can initiate return request from order details for eligible items.
2. System validates eligibility (window, item status) and records request.
bidderNote: (Supported with configuration and the marketplace return module)

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to select a return reason from a standardized list and provide free-text details and evidence attachments where permitted.
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to select a return reason from a standardized list and provide free-text details and evidence attachments where permitted.
rationale: Supports transparent returns handling and dispute resolution.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Return request captures reason code and optional notes/photos.
2. Evidence attachments are stored and linked to return case.

text: The Platform shall support configurable return shipping models (merchant-paid, customer-paid, shared, MPC-subsidized) based on Table 10 and policy configuration.
shall: The Platform shall support configurable return shipping models (merchant-paid, customer-paid, shared, MPC-subsidized) based on Table 10 and policy configuration.
rationale: Supports hybrid returns policy options identified in feasibility study.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure return shipping model per category/seller/policy.
2. Return workflow calculates and displays who pays return shipping and how it is collected.

text: The Platform shall create a return logistics task (pickup or drop-off) when a return is approved and provide a return tracking reference.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): RET-003 criteria held by T-MISS (Table 10 return shipping models not provided)
shall: The Platform shall create a return logistics task (pickup or drop-off) when a return is approved and provide a return tracking reference.
rationale: Enables reverse logistics and visibility.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Approved return generates logistics task and tracking reference.
2. Buyer can track return shipment status similarly to outbound.
bidderNote: (Requires Custom Reverse Logistics Module with Courier Integrations)

text: The Platform shall allow sellers to review and respond to return requests within configured timelines.
shall: The Platform shall allow sellers to review and respond to return requests within configured timelines.
rationale: Supports fair process and reduces manual interventions.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Seller can approve, reject, or request more info within allowed period.
2. Buyer receives notification of seller response.

text: The Platform shall provide an escalation path for unresolved return disputes, including routing to MPC dispute resolution process.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): escalation path covered (AC-RET-007-05-01); routing to the Malawi Post dispute process needs the Complaints and ADR Policy (T-MISS)
shall: The Platform shall provide an escalation path for unresolved return disputes, including routing to MPC dispute resolution process.
rationale: Supports consumer protection and complaint handling.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support/Admin can escalate a dispute case and assign it to a resolver.
2. Escalation decisions are logged and visible in case history.

text: The Platform shall initiate a refund workflow upon approved return, order cancellation, or service failure according to policy.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): refund initiation on approved return, cancellation and service failure covered (RET-005, SVC-005); refund amounts "according to policy" not stated in source
shall: The Platform shall initiate a refund workflow upon approved return, order cancellation, or service failure according to policy.
rationale: Ensures timely customer refunds and trust.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Refund workflow triggers automatically when return is approved or cancellation occurs.
2. Refund status is tracked and buyer is notified.

text: The Platform shall support partial returns and partial refunds at item level.
shall: The Platform shall support partial returns and partial refunds at item level.
rationale: Supports real-world scenarios and customer satisfaction.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can request return for selected items within an order.
2. Refund amounts are calculated correctly and recorded.

text: The Platform shall display returns policy and dispute resolution process clearly on product pages and order pages.
notes: Code-level modification | closed by CAT-031 amended, RET-007 mapped; Dispute-resolution process display on product and order pages not described
shall: The Platform shall display returns policy and dispute resolution process clearly on product pages and order pages.
rationale: Builds trust and reduces confusion.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Returns/dispute policy summary is accessible from product and order pages.
2. Policy links are versioned and auditable.

text: The Platform shall provide a case management view for returns and disputes with status, parties, evidence, and decision logging.
shall: The Platform shall provide a case management view for returns and disputes with status, parties, evidence, and decision logging.
rationale: Improves efficiency and governance of dispute handling.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support agent can view all open cases and filter by status and age.
2. Decisions and messages are logged with timestamps and actors.

text: The Platform shall support buyer-seller messaging within a dispute/return case, with moderation and audit trail.
shall: The Platform shall support buyer-seller messaging within a dispute/return case, with moderation and audit trail.
rationale: Improves resolution and reduces external communication leakage.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer and seller can exchange messages within a case.
2. Messages are stored securely and are visible to authorized moderators.

text: The Platform shall enforce return eligibility rules per product category and seller policy (e.g., non-returnable items).
shall: The Platform shall enforce return eligibility rules per product category and seller policy (e.g., non-returnable items).
rationale: Supports enforceable marketplace policies.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Non-returnable items are blocked from return initiation.
2. Eligibility rules are configurable and logged.

text: The Platform shall calculate and record return-related fees (restocking, logistics fees) where applicable, with transparency to buyers.
shall: The Platform shall calculate and record return-related fees (restocking, logistics fees) where applicable, with transparency to buyers.
rationale: Supports sustainable returns handling and fee transparency.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Fees are calculated according to configured policy.
2. Buyer sees fee breakdown and acknowledges before finalizing return.

text: The Platform shall provide evidence capture for delivered items (proof of delivery) and link it to dispute cases.
shall: The Platform shall provide evidence capture for delivered items (proof of delivery) and link it to dispute cases.
rationale: Supports dispute resolution and fraud prevention.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. POD evidence is accessible from dispute case.
2. POD evidence access is RBAC-controlled and logged.

text: The Platform shall allow buyers to request order issue resolution (missing item, damaged item, wrong item) separate from formal returns where policy allows.
shall: The Platform shall allow buyers to request order issue resolution (missing item, damaged item, wrong item) separate from formal returns where policy allows.
rationale: Supports customer service and trust.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can open an issue from order details and select issue type.
2. Issue is routed to seller/support queue and tracked as a case.

text: The Platform shall provide configurable SLA timers for dispute/return handling (seller response time, support resolution time).
shall: The Platform shall provide configurable SLA timers for dispute/return handling (seller response time, support resolution time).
rationale: Improves accountability and service quality.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can configure SLA timers and escalation thresholds.
2. System flags SLA breaches and triggers notifications/escalations.

text: The Platform shall support automated dispute categorization and triage rules based on reason codes and transaction attributes.
shall: The Platform shall support automated dispute categorization and triage rules based on reason codes and transaction attributes.
rationale: Improves efficiency and scalable operations.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. At least two triage rules can be configured and demonstrated.
2. Cases are routed to queues per triage rules.

text: The Platform shall provide clear refund status tracking and expected timelines for refund completion per payment method.

shall: The Platform shall provide clear refund status tracking and expected timelines for refund completion per payment method.
rationale: Improves transparency and reduces support calls.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Buyer can view refund status and last update timestamp.
2. Refund timelines are displayed based on configured policy per payment method.

text: The Platform shall support reversal handling for mobile money transactions where a payment is reversed by provider.
shall: The Platform shall support reversal handling for mobile money transactions where a payment is reversed by provider.
rationale: Ensures financial accuracy and consistent order states.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Provider reversal is ingested and updates payment/order states per rule.
2. Reversal is recorded with provider reference.
bidderNote: (The custom module to be integrated with mobile money provider module)

text: The Platform shall support refund approval controls and segregation of duties for manual refunds above a configurable threshold.
shall: The Platform shall support refund approval controls and segregation of duties for manual refunds above a configurable threshold.
rationale: Supports financial controls and fraud prevention.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Manual refunds above threshold require second approver.
2. Approval actions are logged and auditable.

text: The Platform shall provide return labels and/or return instructions for buyers depending on chosen return shipping model.
notes: Code-level modification | COMP-R5 (Proposed, PO to ratify): RET-003 criteria held by T-MISS (Table 10 return shipping models not provided)
shall: The Platform shall provide return labels and/or return instructions for buyers depending on chosen return shipping model.
rationale: Enables smooth return process.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. If label-based, system generates printable label with barcode.
2. If instruction-based, system provides step-by-step return instructions.
bidderNote: (The custom module to be integrated with the logistics module)

text: The Platform shall support dispute escalation to external regulators/ADR channels as applicable (e.g., MACRA) with export of case dossier.
shall: The Platform shall support dispute escalation to external regulators/ADR channels as applicable (e.g., MACRA) with export of case dossier.
rationale: Supports feasibility recommendation on dispute resolution escalation.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support can export case dossier (messages, evidence, decisions) as a file.
2. Export contains required fields and is access-controlled.
bidderNote: (The custom module to be integrated with the external disputes module)

text: The Platform shall support configurable retention of dispute/return case records and evidence per data retention policy.
shall: The Platform shall support configurable retention of dispute/return case records and evidence per data retention policy.
rationale: Supports compliance and storage management.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Admin can set retention policy configuration.

2. System archives or deletes records according to policy and logs actions.3.The System shall maintain an audit trail and records of all deletion and will not allow permanent record removal without approvals

text: The Platform shall generate periodic reports on returns rate, dispute reasons, resolution times, and outcomes.
shall: The Platform shall generate periodic reports on returns rate, dispute reasons, resolution times, and outcomes.
rationale: Supports governance and continuous improvement.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Report can be generated by period and category/seller.
2. Report is exportable and includes key KPIs.

text: The Platform shall support return item inspection at MPC outlet/warehouse (received condition, photos, acceptance/rejection) and record the inspection outcome in the return case.
shall: The Platform shall support return item inspection at MPC outlet/warehouse (received condition, photos, acceptance/rejection) and record the inspection outcome in the return case.
rationale: Improves dispute resolution and accountability for returned goods handled through MPC network.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Ops user can record inspection outcome and attach photos where applicable.
2. Inspection outcome triggers next workflow step (refund approval, seller notification) as configured.

rationale: Supports customer service for e-commerce and e-government services.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can submit a support request with category and description.

clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support agent can create/update ticket status and assign owner.

text: The Platform shall support multi-channel case intake (web/app form, email-to-ticket, phone/call center logging) as configured.
shall: The Platform shall support multi-channel case intake (web/app form, email-to-ticket, phone/call centre logging) as configured.
rationale: Supports call centre operations and improves accessibility.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. At least two intake channels are enabled and demonstrated.
2. All channels create standardized case records.

text: The Platform shall provide a 360-degree customer view for support agents (profile, orders, payments, delivery events, disputes).
shall: The Platform shall provide a 360-degree customer view for support agents (profile, orders, payments, delivery events, disputes).
rationale: Reduces resolution time and improves service quality.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support agent can retrieve customer record by phone/email/order ID.

rationale: Reduces support load and improves user confidence.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. FAQ content is searchable and categorized.

shall: The Platform shall support scripted responses and templates for common inquiries, with version control and approval. And this will be used through AI chat bots achieved though platforms such as Whatsapp , browser chat Support Agents
rationale: Improves consistency and compliance of communications.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support agent can select template response for a ticket.

text: The Platform shall provide order issue reporting functionality (missing parcel, delayed delivery, payment issue) that auto-populates order details in ticket.
shall: The Platform shall provide order issue reporting functionality (missing parcel, delayed delivery, payment issue) that auto-populates order details in ticket.
rationale: Improves support efficiency and reduces user effort.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. User can open a ticket from order details and order metadata is attached.

shall: The Platform shall support escalation workflows from Level 1 support to specialized teams (payments ops, logistics ops, technical support).
rationale: Supports effective resolution of complex issues.
clientAcceptanceCriteria: 1. Support agent can escalate ticket to predefined queue with reason.
